1.title: AI Agents Will Handle Mortgage Origination | Mike Yu
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Vesta CEO on how AI agents are handling 40% of mortgage origination tasks, why mortgages are structurally suited for agent labor transfer, and the company's Series B raise; discusses the shift toward personal AI assistants managing task-level agents.

1.title: AI Implementation Is Making Employees More Lonely | Cesar Carvalho
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Wellhub CEO presents research from Project Healthy Minds on how AI implementation correlates with employee stress, anxiety, and workplace loneliness; frames worker wellbeing as a business investment lever for unlocking AI productivity.

1.title: The 4-Step Agentic Engineering Workflow I Use to Ship Real Apps | Ras Mic
1.author: Peter Yang
1.hook: Full-stack engineer walks through 4-step workflow for shipping agentic systems at scale: task isolation, structured agent scaffolding, validation loops for output quality, and agent-reviewed PRs with manual escalation. Covers why most agentic projects fail, what tasks stay human-owned, and tool comparisons (Astra vs Fable).

2.title: Why AI Agents Need Human Harnesses | Robert Vis
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Robert Vis (Bird CEO) on scaling AI agents via MCP and CLI harnesses, reducing headcount from 1,000 to 120 through automation, and the mechanics of a $450M debt financing round for dividend recapitalization.

3.title: Frontier AI Models Will Run Local in 6 Months | Zain Javaid
3.author: MTS
3.hook: Zain Javaid (Ghost CEO) discusses local frontier AI models, the $3,500 Core hardware device for 24/7 autonomous agents, and why current consumer AI on phones/laptops is architecturally constrained; covers privacy, open-weight model progression, and emerging use cases.

4.title: Why every company now needs to think and operate like a lab team | Josh Woodward (VP Google Labs)
4.author: Lenny's Podcast
4.hook: Josh Woodward (Google Labs) on building experimental product cultures at scale — "almost possible" framework, recognizing product-market fit, when to kill ideas, skills rising in value (unlearning rate, explosive endurance, trust), why roles aren't collapsing into one universal builder role, and internal labs setup.

1.title: Building Self-Learning Loops for Your Agent — Fuad Ali, Arize AI
1.author: AI Engineer
1.hook: Concrete walkthrough of an agent consuming observability data (traces, signals, datasets) to autonomously detect, investigate, and propose fixes for production failures — using a shopping assistant budget-filter bug as the worked example. Shows Arize Skills integration, evaluation harnesses that check tool calls and external context, agent experiments that replay failure datasets, and a human-reviewable repair loop.

2.title: AI R&D Is Approaching an Explosive Feedback Loop | Tom Davidson
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Tom Davidson on P Zero's "Tasteval" benchmark showing AI systems doubling in research taste every three months; explores recursive self-improvement vs foom dynamics and implications for lab productivity and national security.

1.title: General Robots Will Be Solved by 2028 | Jay Chooi
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Robotics safety benchmarking (RoboHarm framework) comparing GPT-6 Astra and Claude; claims general-purpose robots solvable by 2028; discusses AI-induced economic disempowerment and multi-agent governance.

2.title: The End of 30-Year Mortgage Servicing | Valon
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Valon's founders explain why they divested mortgage servicing to focus on software, and how AI agents need operational context (not just raw intelligence) to handle complex financial contracts. They discuss new products enabled by low-friction servicing infrastructure.
